description: Comprehensive service decomposition of monolithic AkshareService into focused, single-responsibility services
approach: Extract 6 distinct services from the 1202-line monolithic AkshareService: CatalogService (metadata/seeding), SchedulerService (job management), HttpClientService (request execution), ParserService (data parsing with strategy pattern), PersistenceService (bulk upsert/chunking), and StatusService (error tracking). Each service has clear boundaries and minimal coupling.

tasks.title: Create AkshareParserService with Strategy Pattern
tasks.description: Extract all parser methods into a dedicated ParserService using Strategy pattern. This addresses DSC-MAINT-002 (hardcoded switch) and DSC-QUAL-003 (duplicated patterns) simultaneously.

modification_points.reason: Define IParser interface for strategy pattern
Abstract base class with shared deduplication logic

implementation: Create IParser interface with parse(config, payload, context): ParsedDataPoint[]
Create BaseParser abstract class with shared methods: normalizeNumber(), parseDate(), parseYearMonthDate(), deduplicatePoints()
Implement 5 concrete parsers extending BaseParser, each handling specific parser type
Create ParserRegistry class with register() and get() methods for O(1) lookup
Create AkshareParserService that uses registry instead of switch statement
Export all parsers from parsers/index.ts barrel file

unit: Each concrete parser with sample payloads

criteria: No switch statement in parsePayload method

commit.message_template: refactor(akshare): extract parsers into strategy pattern with registry
